result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane signalized intersection that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks or dedicated pedestrian signals. The environment is dominated by vehicle-centric design with long crossing distances and minimal separation between pedestrians and traffic.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, making pedestrian movements unpredictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian signal heads are present to indicate when it is safe to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers synchronized with the traffic lights.

result.summary: The image shows a wide multi-lane arterial road with a signalized intersection and faded crosswalk markings. Pedestrians face a long unprotected crossing distance across four lanes of traffic, exacerbated by intense sun glare that reduces driver visibility.

hazards.name: Sun glare
hazards.description: Intense glare from the low sun directly faces one direction of traffic, potentially blinding drivers to pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The four-lane width without a median refuge increases pedestrian exposure time.

hazards.name: Faded markings
hazards.description: Worn crosswalk paint reduces the visual cue for drivers to expect pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-visibility markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with high-visibility continental markings to improve crossing conspicuity.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Construct a median island to provide a safe waiting area and reduce unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, high-volume intersection with multiple travel lanes and significant crossing distances for pedestrians. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of refuge islands and faded crosswalk markings increase the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to multiple lanes of traffic for an extended period without a refuge.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: Existing crosswalk markings are worn and difficult to see, reducing their effectiveness in alerting drivers to pedestrian presence.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked and moving vehicles can block sight lines between pedestrians and drivers at the crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages and reduce exposure time.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply continental-style markings to all legs of the intersection to improve visibility for approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by a high-speed slip lane with a marked zebra crosswalk but no signalization. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway geometry and lack of traffic calming measures prioritize vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: High-speed slip lane
hazards.description: The dedicated right-turn lane allows vehicles to maintain higher speeds while crossing the pedestrian path, increasing the risk of high-impact collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image where the crosswalk is located across the turning lane.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signalization
hazards.description: There are no signals to stop traffic or indicate when it is safe for pedestrians to cross the slip lane, forcing pedestrians to judge gaps in traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: At the crosswalk across the slip lane.

interventions.title: Slip Lane Reconstruction
interventions.description: Reconstruct the slip lane to a tighter radius or a 'smart channel' to force vehicles to slow down and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing beacons to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrians' signs to alert drivers of the crossing point.
